## Tech Stack
- Markdown + YAML frontmatter — system map artifact format
- Mermaid diagram syntax — C4 Level 1-2 diagrams (flowchart + classDef approach)
- Bash — session-start hook modifications (grep, sed, python3 one-liners)
- Claude Code skill format — `.claude/skills/cortex-map/SKILL.md`

## Conventions
- System map lives at `docs/cortex/system-map.md` (project root, not per-slug)
- Skills read the map directly via `Read` tool — no hook injection of full content
- Session-start hook injects pointer + freshness status only (~50 tokens)
- Map updates always require human confirmation — no auto-writes
- Freshness envelope in YAML frontmatter: `last_verified`, `valid_until`, `confidence`, `advisory: true`

## Architecture Rules
- Pointer injection via hook, full reads by skills (not full hook injection — 10K char cap)
- Map is advisory, never a blocking gate — commands proceed normally if map is missing
- Content split: "derived" sections (refreshable from code) vs "asserted" sections (human-maintained)
- Token budget: target 3K, hard ceiling 5K
- Replaces per-slug `project-context.md` pattern for new slugs
